pages.en:
——I will find Tohsaka.

She told me to withdraw here.

If I intend to refuse and continue fighting, then I have to make her understand.

I have no intention of withdrawing, and our alliance is still in effect.

Besides—
pages.mirrorMoon:
I’ll go find Tohsaka.
She told me to forfeit.
If I’m going to ignore her advice and fight, I have to make her realize…
That I’m not going to give up, and that we’re still cooperating.
And

pages.ja:
ここで、あいつ一人に戦わせるなんてできるものか。
あいつには大きな借りがある。
それを返すまで降板なんて出来ない。
pages.jaRuby:
ここで、あいつ一人に戦わせるなんてできるものか。
あいつには大きな借りがある。
それを返すまで降板なんて出来ない。
pages.en:
how could I let her fight alone now?

I owe her an enormous debt.

I cannot leave the stage until I have repaid it.
pages.mirrorMoon:
I can’t let her fight by herself.
I owe her bigtime.
I can’t forfeit until I repay her for that.

pages.ja:
「……しかもあいつ、ここ一番で失敗するし……危なっかしくて、一人になんて、させておけない」
竹刀袋を背負い直す。
……自分が大した戦力にならない事も、あいつが反対する事も分かっている。
それでも遠坂の顔を見ないと安心できない。
pages.jaRuby:
「……しかもあいつ、ここ一番で失敗するし……危なっかしくて、一人になんて、させておけない」
竹刀袋を背負い直す。
……自分が大した戦力にならない事も、あいつが反対する事も分かっている。

pages.en:
“…And she always fails when it matters most… She's too reckless. I can't… let her go alone.”

I settle the shinai bag more firmly upon my shoulder.

…I know that I will not be much help in battle. I know she will object.

Even so, I will not rest easy until I see Tohsaka's face.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“…And she always screws up at the crucial moment… And she’s so unreliable that I can’t let her be alone.”
I adjust the shinai bag on my shoulder.
…I know I won’t be of much help and that she will object.
But I can’t obtain peace of mind until I see Tohsaka’s face.

pages.ja:
……だって、例えばの話。
もし俺の知らないところで怪我なんかされたら、今のままじゃ、手を貸す事も出来ないんだから

…Because suppose, for example,

that she were injured somewhere beyond my sight. As I am now, I could not even lend her a hand—
pages.mirrorMoon:
…This is just a what-if…
But if she gets injured away from me, I can’t even be there to help her

ふう」
ベンチに腰を下ろして、火照った体を休ませる。
時刻は正午を過ぎた。
その間、新都中を探し回って得た物は何もない。
pages.jaRuby:

pages.en:
“——Phew.”

I sit upon a bench and give my fevered body a rest.

It is past noon.

I have spent the intervening hours searching throughout Shinto and found nothing.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“
Phew.”
I sit down on a bench and rest my burning body.
It’s past noon.
I’ve searched all around Shinto, but I haven’t found anything.

pages.ja:
「……くそ。簡単にはいかないと思ったけど、ここまで無反応なんて」
遠坂を捜す手段がない、なんてのは始めから解っていた。
有るか無いかの偶然に期待して街を捜したところで、あいつの姿はおろか痕跡さえ発見できない。

pages.en:
“…Damn it. I knew it wouldn't be easy, but I didn't expect absolutely nothing.”

I understood from the beginning that I had no means of finding Tohsaka.

I have searched the city on the vanishingly small chance of a fortunate encounter, yet found neither her nor the faintest trace of her passage.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“…Damn. I knew it wasn’t going to be easy, but I didn’t think I would find nothing.”
I knew from the start that I had no way to find Tohsaka.
I let my luck take over and searched through the town, but I couldn’t find her, nor any traces of her.

pages.ja:
「……他のマスターも出てこない。……令呪がない以上、ちょっかい出す必要もないって事か」
はあ、と大きく深呼吸をして、背もたれに体を預ける。
pages.jaRuby:
「……他のマスターも出てこない。……令呪がない以上、ちょっかい出す必要もないって事か」
はあ、と大きく深呼吸をして、背もたれに体を預ける。
pages.en:
“…None of the other Masters are appearing either. Now that I don't have a Command Spell, I suppose I'm not worth bothering with.”

I draw a long breath and lean against the back of the bench.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“…The other Masters aren’t coming out either… I guess there’s no need to attack me now that I don’t have my Command Spell.”
I sigh and lay back.

」

遠坂は俺に尻尾を見せるほど甘くないし、自分を囮にして他のマスターを呼び寄せる、という最後の手段も空ぶっている。

pages.en:
“————”

This is getting me nowhere.

Tohsaka is not careless enough to leave a trail for me, and even my final resort—using myself as bait to draw out another Master—has met with nothing but empty air.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“
”
I’m making no progress like this.
Tohsaka hasn’t left any trace, and my last resort of using myself as bait to lure out other Masters is failing so far.

pages.ja:
……僅かな不安が生じる。
遠坂は見つけられず、セイバーも助けられない。
そうして二人を見つけだせた時には、もう取り返しのつかない状況になっているのではないかと

pages.en:
…A small unease takes root.

I cannot find Tohsaka. I cannot save Saber.

And by the time I finally locate them, matters may already have passed beyond repair—
pages.mirrorMoon:
…I get a bit uneasy.
I might not be able to find Tohsaka, and I might not be able to save Saber.
They might already be in a terrible situation by the time I find them

「
まだ昼だ。そう簡単にいくもんか」
ベンチから立ち上がる。
熱を持ち出した左肩を無視して、公園を後にする。

pages.en:
“——It's only noon. It was never going to be that easy.”

I rise from the bench.

Ignoring the heat returning to my left shoulder, I leave the park.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“
It’s still noon. I won’t let that happen so easily.”
I get back up.
I ignore the renewed throbbing in my shoulder and leave the park.

pages.ja:
もう一度、始めから捜し直そう。
新都にあいつがいる事に間違いはない。
昨夜と同じだ。
どんな理屈だかは知らないが、あいつ
いや、ヤツがこの辺りに居る事だけは直感できる。
それは予感などといった不確かな物ではなく、確信に近いイメージだった。

pages.en:
I will begin the search again from the start.

There is no doubt that she is somewhere in Shinto.

It is the same as last night.

I cannot explain why, but I know by instinct that she—no, that *he*—is somewhere nearby.

It is not the vague uncertainty of a premonition, but an image approaching conviction.
pages.mirrorMoon:
I’ll search one more time.
I’m sure that she’s in Shinto.
It’s just like last night.
I don’t know why, but I can feel that “he” is around here.
It’s not something ambiguous like a premonition. This is a certain knowledge, like a conviction.
